quotes.speaker: Scottie Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes on team excitement and defensive focus
quotes.excerpt: play defense is our main priority, win games.
quotes.quote: I think we are pretty excited as a team. We are ready to get the show on the road. We put in a lot of work this summer and we just want to go out there, execute, play hard, play defense is our main priority, and win games.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes says the Raptors are ready to get the show on the road after a long summer of work. The team is prioritizing defense and execution as they head into the new season.

structured.context: Scottie Barnes discusses the team's excitement and focus on defensive intensity heading into the new season.

quotes.speaker: Scottie Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes on championship expectations and building consistency
quotes.excerpt: we have the highest level of expectation and we want to win a championship here.
quotes.quote: I think we have the highest level of expectation and we want to win a championship here and that is our expectation every time we step on the floor. But it is about how can we build upon that through our every game. You just cannot get there overnight, you have to go through the season and focus on these games first in order to get to the playoffs and in order to get to the championship.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes on the Raptors championship goals: We have the highest level of expectation and we want to win a championship here. But he notes you cannot get there overnight and the focus remains on the daily grind.

structured.context: Scottie Barnes shares his championship expectations and the importance of maintaining consistency throughout the long season.

quotes.speaker: Scottie Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes on team identity and aggressive playstyle
quotes.excerpt: that was our main identity and we was trying to focus on how can we be aggressive.
quotes.quote: That was our main identity and we was trying to focus on how can we be aggressive. I think we set a tone every time we stepped out there on the floor. Our pace was different. I do not think we was really guarding how we should and then all of a sudden you see us start playing faster, moving the ball more, getting tons of assists, then we start being super aggressive, denying, trying to get steals every play, being physical, borderline fouling.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes reflects on the Raptors identity: We started being super aggressive, denying, trying to get steals every play, being physical, borderline fouling. The team is looking to maintain that intensity.

structured.context: Scottie Barnes reflects on the team's aggressive identity and the shift toward faster play and ball movement.

quotes.speaker: Scottie Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes on balancing pressure and smart play
quotes.excerpt: we are going to continue to pressure, but I think we are going to be smart with it.
quotes.quote: I think that we are going to continue to pressure, but I think we are going to be smart with it as well. A lot of times we are pressuring, we are gambling, and then it kind of teams get easy buckets off that. After watching film, we just had to be smart in those situations where okay, sometimes it is great to pick up, let's set the tone, let's guard, but sometimes teams just are scoring off that with these and we are just gambling. So we are just trying to be smart, when do we want to gamble, how can we be handsy in situations where we are just guarding the ball or just trying to keep the ball in front of us, rather than just trying to get out the play and make bad decisions as a team.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes admits the Raptors gambled too much on defense last season. The goal now is to be smart with pressure rather than just gambling and giving up easy buckets.

structured.context: Scottie Barnes explains the need to balance aggressive defensive pressure with smarter decision-making to avoid giving up easy baskets.

quotes.speaker: Scottie Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes on defensive philosophy and ball pressure
quotes.excerpt: I feel like when I pressure the ball, that is my best defense.
quotes.quote: I feel like when I pressure the ball, that is my best defense. Like when I give space, that is when I typically get beat. But I feel like me using my hands and and my active my activity and my you know, energy on ball is something that especially like when I am guarding like the five or the four, you know, it kind of because we already have the one and two being guarded by top defenders in the league. So you know, making that help for everybody on the court is going to be very crucial in creating more turnovers, more transition, more fast break opportunities and stuff like that. So me just doing my part in in our defense is going to be very, very huge.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes says his best defense is pressuring the ball. He believes his activity on the perimeter helps create turnovers and transition opportunities for the entire Raptors squad.

structured.context: Scottie Barnes explains his role in the team's defensive scheme, specifically his focus on ball pressure.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on defensive intensity and league trends
quotes.excerpt: there is much more full court pressure, there is much more on ball aggressiveness.
quotes.quote: We got to do it more. There is no way back. I think the whole league is going that direction. I am watching other teams around the league and in the preseason there is much more full court pressure, there is much more on ball aggressiveness and that is a staple of our defense. We got to really dominate the in that area and we got to take it to to another level. For us, our identity really starts on defense, like how how aggressive we are going to be, how how we are going to be guarding the ball, how we are going to be covering for each other.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic says the whole NBA is trending toward more full court pressure. He wants the Raptors to dominate in that area as it is the staple of their defensive identity.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic emphasizes the importance of defensive intensity and full-court pressure as the team's core identity.
